```yaml
rules:
- id: "vuln-mcp-server-taskwarrior-1ee3d282"
  pattern: |
    execSync(
      $COMMAND |> pattern-inside: `task ${...}`
    )
  pattern-not: |
    execFileSync(
      'task',
      [...],
      { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 * 10 }
    )
  languages: ["typescript"]
  message: |
    Vulnerable use of execSync detected. 
    execSync executes shell commands which can lead to command injection vulnerabilities.
    Replace with execFileSync which avoids shell interpretation.
    
    Fix by replacing:
    execSync(`task ${...}`)
    
    With:
    execFileSync('task', [...], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 * 10 })
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: github.com/awwaiid/mcp-server-taskwarrior/commit/1ee3d282debfa0a99afeb41d22c4b2fd5a3148f2
    category: security
    cwe: [CWE-78]
    owasp: [A01:2021-Injection]
    references: [https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Command_Injection]
    technology: [typescript]
```
